Question

Let’s say you want to make a spirolateral.

If the turn angle is \(105^{\circ}\) and the maximum segment length is \(18\), then which spirolateral is created?

You can use this tool:

https://artockthedino.github.io/pbl/spirolateral/spirolateral_generator.html


Answerlist

  • A
  • B
  • C
  • D
  • E
  • F
  • G
  • H

Solution

The correct answer is B.

Below I’ve listed the parameters used to generate all patterns:

  • A:
    • Turn angle = 135
    • Count max = 9

  • B:
    • Turn angle = 105
    • Count max = 18

  • C:
    • Turn angle = 15
    • Count max = 17

  • D:
    • Turn angle = 153
    • Count max = 14

  • E:
    • Turn angle = 144
    • Count max = 13

  • F:
    • Turn angle = 150
    • Count max = 15

  • G:
    • Turn angle = 60
    • Count max = 13

  • H:
    • Turn angle = 114
    • Count max = 18
